name: H. Harry Asada
title: Ford Professor of Engineering; Professor of Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: Concrete connection between neural dynamics representations and physical contact-rich manipulation, alongside a long-running robot systems lab.

physicalEvidence.summary: Primary contact-dynamics paper (November 2025 preprint; accepted Nature Communications April 13, 2026) uses a Deep Koopman Network to learn lifting observables for convex MPC and executes dynamic pushing/shoving with a real UR5e. Neural training data come from modeled nonlinear dynamics, with friction fitted to physical-system data. The rimless-wheel locomotion portion is simulation; measured 5.2 ms mean runtimes are simulated runs, not a blanket hardware timing guarantee.

shortVisit.summary: Current faculty/lab pages establish advising and a visiting-engineer roster, but no applicable current external-master's short-visit invitation was verified. General MIT Visiting Student rules and historical visitors do not establish an Asada summer opening.
